observations.identity: Clean-shaven angular face, dark sculpted waved curls, ivory open-collar shirt, black waistcoat, shoulder chains and brass padlock follow the accepted Houdini design. Expression is calmer and facial modeling somewhat softer/younger than the 1a figure; identity is an original design interpretation, not an exact face transfer. No Bess substitution.
observations.craftsmanship: Coherent sculpted locks, chain links, padlock and painted cloth texture support the miniature bust style. Skin is smooth and comparatively naturalistic; source-only candidate, not claimed as a scanned or rendered physical miniature.
observations.background: Plain charcoal with a slight tonal gradient; no scenery, lettering, UI, frame or watermark seen. Not numerically uniform.
observations.source_framing: Whole hair silhouette and both ears retained. Top margin is visually about 20%, eye line near 44%, with centered visible eyes. Chains and full brass padlock visible; lower torso naturally exits bottom of square.
observations.circular_full100: Centered circle diameter 100% of square preserves hair, ears, face and padlock. Lower outer shoulder/sleeve edges are clipped by circle, as expected. Padlock sits near lower arc; tighter crops could remove its bottom. Keep full100 with no zoom.
observations.native_80: Hair, face and broad chain/padlock motif read; small link detail is reduced.
observations.native_40: Face becomes very small because generous headroom is retained; individual eyes, expression and chain link geometry do not reliably resolve. Brass lock is a tiny accent. No alternate zoom/crop was substituted.
